title: Chunking, Hybrid Search & Reranking
summary: RAG quality is dominated by retrieval design: how you chunk, what you index, how you fuse lexical and dense signals, and how you rerank before generation.

sections.title: Chunking is an API contract
paragraphs: Chunk size, overlap, and metadata (title, section path, ACLs, timestamps) determine what the model can cite. Over-long chunks dilute embeddings; over-short chunks lose context. Structure-aware chunking (headings, tables) usually beats fixed character windows.

sections.title: Hybrid retrieval and reranking
paragraphs: Lexical search (BM25) handles rare identifiers; dense vectors handle paraphrase. Fuse candidates (e.g. reciprocal rank fusion) then apply a cross-encoder or LLM reranker on a shortlist. Always enforce document ACLs before the prompt is built.
